text: What is one activity you enjoy after classes?
After classes, I enjoy playing badminton with my friends because it helps me relax.
Why do you prefer studying in a library?
I prefer studying in a library because it is quiet, and I can focus without interruptions.
Describe a teacher who influenced you.
My biology teacher influenced me by explaining difficult ideas clearly and encouraging me to ask questions.
How do you usually spend a free weekend?
On a free weekend, I usually visit my family, cook dinner, and prepare for the following week.
